title: Misty Mine
subtitle: Crystal Minds and Shattered Souls, Ancient Chest with the unknown crystal at the bottom
steps: In the Warehouse, take the Surface portal to the Misty Mine.
At the bottom, take an unknown crystal from an Ancient Chest.
Give it to the Student in Glenden Wood.

notes.title: Flashing lights
notes.body: The Misty Mine has a strong flashing light effect. Be careful if you are sensitive to flashing images.

notes.title: Which chest
notes.body: All seven Ancient Chests at the bottom hold an unknown crystal, so take whichever is free. They refill 30 seconds after being emptied.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Haze Golems take full cold (1.0) and 0.85 electric, but only 0.1 physical damage. Voltaic Golems take full electric and 0.85 cold, and are immune to fire.

notes.title: Getting in
notes.body: The entrance portals are in the Warehouse (the Surface and Warehouse Annex Mine portals there both lead here). You need to be level 40.
